title: locationSuggestion
description: A location that matches the text the user typed so far.

type.description:
What kind of location is suggested.

- `street`: a street within one postal code, like `Lentedreef, 3010 Kessel-Lo`.
- `address`: a house number on a street, like `Lentedreef 27, 3010 Kessel-Lo`. Only suggested when a house number is typed.
- `municipality`: a municipality, like `Leuven`, or a part of one with its own postal code, like `Kessel-Lo (3010)`.
- `place`: a UiTdatabank place where activities happen, like `Het Depot (Martelarenplein 12, 3000 Leuven)`. Only places that Search API returns by default, with coordinates, in Belgium.

More types can be added later, so ignore a type you don't know or treat it by its `searchFilter`.

label.description: The text to show to the user.
